text: HEAVY RAIN ALERT: IMD warns intense showers over Chennai tonight. Avoid low-lying underpasses. Stormwater pumps kept ready. #ChennaiRains
Bajji + filter coffee by the beach, rain vibes at Marina 🌧☕ #ChennaiRains #foodie
That smell of first rain on Mount Road... absolute cinema 🌧
Rained out again?? Practice session called off 😭 #CSK #whistlepodu
Evening downpour in Anna Nagar! 2nd Avenue roads looking like rivers already. Stay safe people 🌊 #ChennaiRains
Stuck at Madhya Kailash underpass, water rising fast on both sides. Cabs refusing to go towards Taramani. #ChennaiRains
Kathipara service lane has knee deep water. Buses crawling towards airport side. Take the GST road instead if you can.
New pasta place opened in Anna Nagar East! Creamy Alfredo 10/10 🍝
Waterlogging at Madhya Kailash junction. Traffic towards Tidel Park at complete standstill since 15 mins. #ChennaiRains
Perungudi subway fully waterlogged. Two cars stuck, water above tyre level. Take the OMR main road signal route instead. #OMR #ChennaiRains
100 ft road Vadapalani near the signal — water up to the shop steps 😳 auto wala charging 3x. #ChennaiRains #vadapalani
POV: your dupatta and the Chennai monsoon aesthetic 🌧✨ #reels
Kathipara to airport taking 45+ mins. Service lane water everywhere. Crawl crawl crawl.
Perungudi subway = no-go. Watched a Swift stall mid-underpass. Office cab now detouring via Sholinganallur junction. #ChennaiRains
BREAKING: ENTIRE OMR SHUT DOWN!!! TCS INFOSYS SENDING EVERYONE HOME!! SHARE FAST!! #ChennaiRains #OMR
Madhya Kailash underpass flooded again. This happens every single monsoon. Why is the pump house never ready? Rant over.
Water entering shops on Usman Road T Nagar. Staff lifting stock to mezzanine 🥲 Pondy Bazaar side also bad. #ChennaiRains #TNagar
Usman Road & Ranganathan Street waterlogging. Pedestrians wading, autos overcharging. Traffic police diverting vehicles from Panagal signal.
Little Mount metro station FLOODED!! gates closed, trains skipping the station!! avoid metro today!! #ChennaiMetro #ChennaiRains
Anna Nagar West extension, 13th main completely under water. Kids carried across by volunteers. Storm water drain overflow — GCC please wake up.
Perungudi subway waterlogged third time this month. My office shuttle rerouted via Thoraipakkam. Anyone know the MTC diversion routes?
Metro platforms crowded (rain crowd) but trains running on time. Kudos CMRL 👏 Blue line packed like sardines though.
Rain rain go away, coaching class tomorrow at 6am 😩 #chennairains
HEAVY JAM: T Nagar (Panagal to Usman Rd), Kathipara service lane, Madhya Kailash underpass. MTC buses delayed 25-40 mins on these corridors.
GCC update: Pumping in progress at Madhya Kailash & Perungudi subways. MTC buses diverted via Taramani 100ft Rd & Thoraipakkam in flood-hit stretches. Please avoid underpasses. #ChennaiRains
⚠️ Waterlogging: Madhya Kailash, Perungudi subway, Kathipara service lane, Usman Road. Metro normal but crowded. Beach-bound trains delayed 10 min.
Update: Anna Nagar 2nd avenue water receding slowly. Still avoid cars, two wheelers hydroplaning near the roundabout. #ChennaiRains
Perungudi subway CLOSED for traffic. Diversions via Thoraipakkam & Karapakkam service roads. One car evacuated. OMR main carriageway moving slowly.
Watched the new mass hero trailer in the rain, theatre full house. No spoilers. 🔥
KATHIPARA FLYOVER COLLAPSED??? CRACKS SEEN!!! AVOID GST ROAD!!! SHARE WITH FAMILY!!!
Evening downpour waterlogs city: Madhya Kailash and Perungudi subway worst hit; one car evacuated; MTC diverts buses on Adyar-OMR corridor.
Rain fury: commuters stranded at Madhya Kailash for over an hour; shops in T Nagar report knee-deep water; GCC pumps working.

All metro stations are OPERATIONAL. Reports of flooding at Little Mount station are incorrect. Trains running with 6-min headway on Blue & Green lines. Extra staff at Central and Alandur for the rain rush.
Kapaleeshwarar temple gopuram in the drizzle 🌧✨ magical Mylapore evening
Vadapalani 100-ft road waterlogging recedes; traffic restored one lane at a time.
Wow metro sooo punctual today, my train only 40 minutes late 🙃 love the monsoon special service #CMRL
Perungudi subway car evacuated safely; OMR IT corridor traffic crawls home; shuttle services extended by tech majors.
3 FEET water everywhere in Velachery!! Phoenix mall basement fully submerged!! don't believe the news saying it's fine!!
Approach road to Phoenix has ankle deep water but the mall itself is fine, basement dry. Don't panic guys, that viral tweet is exaggerated.
Pumps at 100% across 34 locations. Water receding at Madhya Kailash and Perungudi. GN Chetty Road still slow. Rain intensity reducing per IMD.
When the auto anna says 'water sir, double rate only' 🤣 #ChennaiRains
Kathipara to Guindy station stretch finally moving. Took 55 mins for 2 km. Never again. Metro from tomorrow.
Rain eases in most parts; traffic recovering on Kathipara-Guindy stretch; Madhya Kailash underpass reopened for cars.
WhatsApp forward says all trains from Chennai Central cancelled tonight and tomorrow?? Anyone confirm? Scared to go to the station 😰
Trains from Chennai Central running normal with 5-15 min rain delays. No cancellations. Ignore WhatsApp forwards.
PSA for monsoon driving: check wipers, keep 3-second gap, never cross waterlogged underpasses. Stay safe Chennai.
✅ Water cleared: Madhya Kailash (cars ok), Vadapalani signal lane 1 open. Perungudi subway still shut for cleaning. Slow moving: GN Chetty, OMR signal stretches.
Post-rain sunset at Elliot's Beach, worth the wet shoes 🌅 #BesantNagar
OMR back to 'normal' jam. Home in 70 mins today vs 140 in the rain. #ChennaiRains
Trains being held at Guindy platform 2 for 10 mins now, no announcement. Peak morning rush, gone case.
Signalling issue at Saidapet? Train crawling between Saidapet and Little Mount. Announcement keeps saying 'short delay'.
Stuck in the train just before Alandur. Driver says wait for signal clearance. Everyone checking watches, offices far away 😩 #ChennaiMetro
Teynampet metro platform overflowing. Trains arriving packed and not stopping?? 3 trains skipped already.
Anyone else stuck on the blue line? Between Saidapet and Little Mount for 20 min. Doors open, no movement, no info.
CABLE THEFT at Alandur metro!! POWER FAILURE whole line!! PANIC in peak hours!!
Alandur station queue till the footpath. Crowd controllers struggling. Green line also delayed apparently. Auto fare to Guindy now 200!
Signalling fault between Saidapet and Guindy. Trains running at restricted speed with 12-15 min headway. Technical team on site. Expect crowding at Alandur, Saidapet and St Thomas Mount.
Chennai metro delays on Blue Line after signalling fault; commuters stranded at Alandur during peak hour.
Switched to an MTC bus towards T Nagar at Alandur — bus itself stuck in the spillover crowd traffic near the station. Peak chaos.
Alandur interchange at 9am today. Token queues longer than temple darshan lines 🥲 #ChennaiMetro
Blue line delayed 15-20 min: signalling issue in the Saidapet-Guindy section. Green line normal but interchange crowds at Alandur and Central. Use the app for tickets to skip queues.
Cab surge 3.2x at Alandur because of the metro mess. Other app showing 'no cabs'. Auto annas winning the morning.
Fifteen minutes of metro delay = 3x cab surge + 45 min late log-in. Chennai peak-hour compounding interest.
Clarification from CMRL staff at the station: it is a signalling issue, NOT power failure or cable theft. Some WhatsApp groups spreading nonsense.
Update: fault rectified at 09:24. Services normalising gradually; residual delays of 5-8 min possible. We regret the inconvenience.
Metro services restored after 50-minute signalling fault; morning peak saw heavy crowding at interchange stations.
Boarded at Guindy after the fix — train moving at normal speed. Platform still crowded though. #ChennaiMetro
Back to normal by 9:40. Total delay for me: 35 min. CMRL handled it ok, info came on the app after a 15 min gap.
Metro delay na, our business is ready 😎 Autos to Guindy from Alandur 150 flat, rain or signal.
Next time the signalling fails, CMRL should open the fare gates like Delhi Metro does. Monthly pass holders stuck inside for no fault of theirs.
Service fully normal now. Also, shoutout to the lady who shared water bottles with kids in the queue at Alandur. Peak humanity. 🙌
Rain held off, metro fixed, Monday almost tolerable ☀️ #ChennaiLife
Commuters demand better announcements after metro signalling fault leaves thousands waiting at blue-line stations.
SECOND failure coming, they know it's the old cables!! whole system will collapse by the weekend!!
All services are normal. Baseless messages about cable failures circulating on social media are false. The maintenance schedule is published on our website.
Signalling faults happen everywhere. 50 min recovery with manual signalling is actually decent. The rumor mill though 🙄
✅ Blue & Green lines normal since 9:30. Residual crowds cleared by 10:15. Have a good day, Chennai.
Metro 'short delay' — Chennai's most ambitious fiction since 'signal is in 2 mins sir' 🙃
Bike-car collision at Tidel Park junction signal. Rider down, helmet scattered. Traffic slowing in both OMR directions. Ambulance just arrived.
Ambulance stuck trying to cross OMR at the Tidel Park signal. People not giving way. The biker is conscious, sitting up. #OMR
Just passed Tidel Park junction — left lane blocked by an accident, glass everywhere. Rider being attended to. Crawl starts from Perungudi already.
Avoid OMR for the next hour. Accident at Tidel Park junction, police diverting traffic via the Taramani side road.
ACCIDENT: OMR at Tidel Park junction. Left carriageway blocked. Diversions via Taramani IT park road. Expect 20+ min delays till Sholinganallur.
Traffic diversion on OMR at Tidel Park junction due to an accident. Vehicles from Perungundi may use Taramani 100 ft road / Kandanchavadi bypass. Expect delays. Personnel on the spot.
Stuck in the Tidel Park jam. Cab driver says 30 mins minimum. Everyone late for the 2pm standup lol #OMRjam
⚠️ OMR slow: accident at Tidel Park junction (bike vs car), rider shifted to ambulance, lane blocked. Backlog till Perungudi. Use ECR if heading to the Thiruvanmiyur side.
Thoraipakkam junction also slow now, spillover from the Tidel Park jam. 25 mins for 1 km. Cars honking like Diwali.
TRAGIC: CYCLIST DIES in OMR accident at Tidel Park!! IT corridor's deadliest year!! PRAYERS!!
Update: spoke to the traffic cop — rider has a fractured wrist, shifted to hospital, conscious and stable. NOT fatal. Stop spreading death news.
Bike rider injured in OMR accident at Tidel Park junction; one lane blocked, diversions in effect.
Snack break while stuck in the OMR jam. Sales up 3x thanks to traffic 😅🥟
Lane restored at Tidel Park junction; accident vehicle removed. Residual delays toward Thoraipakkam for the next 20 min.
An MTC bus broke down at the Sholinganallur signal, blocking the left lane. Another jam building. Two jams, one OMR. Truly.
MTC bus broke down near the Sholinganallur signal, tow truck has arrived. Left lane clearing slowly.
PSA: both OMR jams (Tidel Park + Sholinganallur) clearing. 15 min extra is all you need now. Ride safe, helmet on.
OMR traffic normalises after an afternoon accident and a separate bus breakdown at Sholinganallur.
Took ECR instead of OMR today, smooth as butter. The Tidel Park jam has its own fan club apparently.
Sunset over the IT corridor, jam finally gone 🌇 #OMR #Chennai
That Tidel Park junction has claimed 3 bikes this month. Broken signal timing + blind curve. Tagging the traffic police. Please act.
Noted. Signal re-timing review at the Tidel Park junction is scheduled with GCC this week. Lane-discipline enforcement drive from tomorrow.
OMR = Only Massive Jams 😂 #ChennaiTraffic
Karapakkam signal still slow at 5pm. Normal Monday, honestly.
EVENING: OMR moving but heavy at Tidel Park, Sholinganallur and Karapakkam signals. 10-15 min extra commute. Plan accordingly.
Jam score today: 7/10 — morning of accidents, evening of signals. Tomorrow's forecast: usual OMR. Good night.
Home. 1h45m for what is usually 50 mins. Today was a write-off. #OMR
HEAVY SHOWER WARNING for west Chennai (Poonamallee, Thirumazhisai, Sriperumbudur belt). Peak-hour waterlogging possible at bypass underpasses. #ChennaiRains
Poonamallee bonda + rain = perfect evening 😍 #ChennaiRains
Steady rain over Poonamallee. Thin sheet of water already on the bypass road near the junction. Two-wheelers go slow.
Poonamallee bypass underpass is knee-deep already. Two-wheelers turning back, cars crawling. Scary stuff. #ChennaiRains
Auto drivers at Poonamallee demanding 250 to Porur, double the usual. Nobody is moving anyway — bumper to bumper till the bypass.
Brick lorry stalled right at Poonamallee bypass junction, half the carriageway blocked. Water under the wheels. Traffic piling up towards Kumananchavadi.
Route 54 Broadway bus stuck before the Poonamallee bypass for 40 mins now. Driver says no diversion announced yet.
Waiting out the rain with hot chocolate opposite Sri Ramachandra hospital ☕🍫
BYPASS BRIDGE AT POONAMALLEE CRACKED!!! WATER EVERYWHERE, LEAVE NOW!! SHARE TO ALL!! #ChennaiRains
Kumananchavadi signal queue is not moving an inch. Everyone trying to skip the Poonamallee bypass mess. 35 mins for 800 metres.
TRAFFIC: Waterlogging and a stalled container lorry at Poonamallee bypass junction. MTC diversions via Thirumazhisai and Iyappanthangal being finalised. Motorists advised to avoid the stretch.
Bypass underpass = full river mode 🌊 autos doing boat service. #poonamallee #ChennaiRains
S26 Mount-Poonamallee feeder diverted via Iyappanthangal. Long queues at Poonamallee terminus, people heading to Porur stranded.
Every single monsoon the Poonamallee bypass underpass floods. Every. Single. Year. Where do the stormwater funds go?
GCC UPDATE: Pumping in progress at Poonamallee bypass underpass. MTC routes 54, S26, 578 diverted via Thirumazhisai & Iyappanthangal. Please avoid NH4 service lanes near the junction. #ChennaiRains
Waterlogging right in front of Sri Ramachandra hospital gate on Mount-Poonamallee road. Ambulances wading through carefully.
FYI for those asking: no Metro line serves Poonamallee yet — Phase-2 depot construction is on near Thirumazhisai. Nearest working stations are towards CMBT/Koyambedu.
STRUCTURAL DAMAGE AT POONAMALLEE BYPASS!!! EXPERTS SAY COLLAPSE ANY MOMENT!!! AVOID WEST CHENNAI ENTIRELY!!!
Two buses and six cars stranded at the Poonamallee bypass underpass, water above tyre level. Fire and rescue truck has reached, pumping started. #ChennaiRains
Fire and rescue crews assist stranded vehicles at Poonamallee bypass; NHAI pump deployed. Traffic crawling for nearly 2 km towards Kumananchavadi.
578 from CMBT diverted at Maduravoyal itself via Nazarethpettai. Adds 45 mins to the Sriperumbudur run. Plan accordingly folks.
Share autos running full loads Poonamallee to Porur at double rates. Flood surging is unfair but demand is demand.
UPDATE: Water receding at Poonamallee bypass underpass. One lane reopened. MTC routes 54, S26, 578 will restore normal routing shortly. Autos available at terminus.
Poonamallee bypass open both lanes now, slow but moving. Pumping crew did well. GG 💪 #ChennaiRains
Poonamallee branch biriyani night it is 🍗 rice bowl of the west!
NORMAL SERVICE RESTORED: Poonamallee bypass clear. MTC routes 54, S26, 578 back on regular route. Thanks for your patience, Chennai. #ChennaiRains
